title: https://lnav.org/external-access-instance-v1.schema.json
description: Written by each running lnav whose external-access server is open, so clients can find and connect to it.

$schema.title: /$schema
$schema.description: The URI that specifies the schema that describes this type of file

pid.title: /pid
pid.description: The ID of the lnav process.  Clients should ignore the file if this process is not running.

name.title: /name
name.description: The name of the instance, set with the --name option of the :external-access command.  Defaults to the name of the directory lnav was started in.

cwd.title: /cwd
cwd.description: The current working directory of lnav, which is updated by the :cd command

paths.title: /paths
paths.description: The paths given on the command-line.  Local paths and glob patterns are absolute; remote paths and URLs are as given.

url.title: /url
url.description: The base URL of the external-access server

port.title: /port
port.description: The port number of the external-access server

api_key.title: /api_key
api_key.description: The API key, before Base64 encoding.  Send it Base64-encoded in the X-Api-Key header.

started.title: /started
started.description: When the server was started, in seconds since the epoch
